statement.p:
For your college interview, you must wear a tie. You own 2 regular (boring) ties and 6 (cool) bow ties.
How many choices do you have for your neck-wear?
You realize that the interview is for clown college, so you should probably wear both a regular tie and a bow tie. How many choices do you have now?
For the rest of your outfit, you have 6 shirts, 5 skirts, 7 pants, and 8 dresses. You want to select either a shirt to wear with a skirt or pants, or just a dress. How many outfits do you have to choose from (not including the choice of ties)?
